part1.title: Part 1 · Match nodes in static drawings
part1.instruction: The four highlighted nodes on the left form a path. Select the same four nodes in the drawing on the right, shown at a different aspect ratio.
part1.targetsNote: Four consecutive path vertices, identical across ARCOL and DARCOL for each graph.

part2.title: Part 2 · Remember a tree’s direction across an animation
part2.instruction: Look at the unmarked drawing for six seconds, then watch its one-second animation. After playback, one tree is marked red. Which direction did that tree point in the first drawing?
